name: creeper-fuse-explode
comment: WP-2.3b. Stone y = 59 and dirt y = 60 over -10..10, a fence row (id 85) at x = 0; day. Player (id 0) at (2.0, 61, 0.5), creeper (id 1) at (-3.0, 61, 0.5), difficulty 1. The creeper walks to the fence and slides along it; EntityCreeper.attackEntity: within 3 blocks the fuse (watcher byte 16 = 1, timeSinceIgnited + 1, the fuse sound on its first tick), at 30 World.createExplosion(creeper, x, y, z, 3) and setEntityDead (the crater: dirt, stone and fence blocks, their drops). The fence keeps the creeper far enough that the port's player (EntityPlayer.attackEntityFrom is WP-2.5: unscaled damage) survives, so random ticks around it go on as in the oracle. rng_state and the creeper's entity_state every tick (absent after the explosion), block_box of the crater area at t = 99.
